name: Changing Woman (Asdzą́ą́ Nádleehé)

domain_history.domain: most revered figure in the Diné pantheon; ages cyclically (old in winter, young by spring) without dying; found as an infant by First Man and First Woman and given the medicine bundle of creation; creates the first Navajo clans from skin rubbed from her own body combined with a sacred mountain-soil bundle; mother (by the Sun) of the Hero Twins; central to the Kinaaldá puberty ceremony, in which a young girl ritually enacts her role

notes: Sourced to Washington Matthews, Navaho Legends (1897), and corroborated across multiple modern summaries (Encyclopedia.com; EBSCO Research Starters; KJZZ/NPR Fronteras Desk reporting).
